title: Agentic AI in Automated Markets
abstract: arXiv:2610.22522v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated markets increasingly host autonomous, learning trading agents and are powered by formulaic automated market makers (AMMs). We study how heterogeneous agent behavior shapes stress, risk-adjusted performance, liquidity, and volatility in these types of markets. Three behavioral archetypes are modeled as agentic reinforcement learning (RL) systems: a rational arbitrageur, a manipulator, and a retail herd-follower. Each archetype is defined by its reward function within a common, asset-agnostic exposure-control environment, and each is trained with a value-based Deep Q-Network (DQN) and with REINFORCE using a learned baseline.   A pilot on hourly cryptocurrency data (AAVE, ETC, SUI) motivates the hypotheses. Herd-followers produce the most frequent but shortest stress episodes, manipulators the fewest but most persistent, and rational agents the most stable rolling Sharpe ratios despite higher return volatility. translated_title: 自动化市场中的智能体AI
translated_abstract: 自动化市场日益由自主的、具备学习能力的交易智能体主导，并由公式化的自动做市商（AMM）提供支撑。我们研究异质智能体行为如何塑造此类市场中的压力、风险调整后绩效、流动性与波动性。论文将三种行为原型建模为智能体强化学习（RL）系统：理性套利者、操纵者和散户羊群追随者。每种原型由其在共同的、与资产无关的敞口控制环境中的奖励函数所定义，并分别使用基于价值的深度Q网络（DQN）和采用学习基线的REINFORCE算法进行训练。基于每小时加密货币数据（AAVE、ETC、SUI）的试点研究为假设提供了启发。结果表明：羊群追随者产生最频繁但最短暂的市场压力事件，操纵者产生最少但最持久的压力事件，而理性智能体尽管收益波动性较高，却拥有最稳定的滚动夏普比率。SHAP归因分析（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文将自动化市场中的交易者建模为三种强化学习智能体（理性套利者、操纵者、散户羊群追随者），揭示了不同行为原型对市场压力、流动性和风险调整后绩效的差异化影响。
en_tdlr: This paper models traders in automated markets as three reinforcement learning agent archetypes (rational arbitrageur, manipulator, and retail herd-follower), revealing their distinct impacts on market stress, liquidity, and risk-adjusted performance.
